title: Setting out paper for collection

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’ll miss tomorrow’s paper collection. Can I leave my bundle with yours? It’s tied so it won’t blow away.
turns.zh: 明天回收紙類時我不在。可以把我的那綑和你的放一起嗎？已經綁好，不會吹散。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. Keep it under the porch roof tonight. The truck won’t take wet paper, even if it’s tied.
turns.zh: 可以，今晚先放在門廊屋簷下。紙濕了就算綁好，回收車也不收。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I’ll leave it there after dinner. Should I move it out before I go?
turns.zh: 晚餐後我會放到那裡。離開前要先搬出去嗎？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. I’ll put both bundles at the curb in the morning. Keep the path to the front door clear.
turns.zh: 不用。我明早會把兩綑都放到路緣旁。請保持通往前門的走道暢通。
